cases.question: Assess write_new_log only. Can it overwrite an existing destination? Can its destination first become visible with partially written content? Does it attempt temporary-file cleanup after a failed link?
Assume valid books containing identical values. Does reordering the object's keys preserve codebook_hash? Does reversing a list containing two distinct messages preserve it?

For validate_record with the specified expected field set, is a Boolean actor name accepted? Is a lone-surrogate string accepted? Must ref be a string when ref is an expected field? Is an unexpected field accepted?
Assess read_records on valid UTF-8 JSONL. Does a literal U+2028 inside a JSON string split a record? Is an intervening blank line accepted? Is one trailing LF accepted?

Assess validate_codebook. Are duplicate exact H1 strings accepted? Is an ordinary prose string without an H1 field code accepted? Is an empty message list accepted? Is the single message S ro accepted?
Assume records have string IDs. Does validate_unique_ids accept two equal IDs? Does it accept differently cased IDs? Does it normalize surrounding whitespace before comparing?
